1. package graphql.kickstart.tools

3. import graphql.Scalars
4. import graphql.introspection.Introspection
5. import graphql.kickstart.tools.directive.SchemaGeneratorDirectiveHelper
6. import graphql.kickstart.tools.util.getDocumentation
7. import graphql.kickstart.tools.util.getExtendedFieldDefinitions
8. import graphql.kickstart.tools.util.unwrap
9. import graphql.language.*
10. import graphql.schema.*
11. import graphql.schema.idl.RuntimeWiring
12. import graphql.schema.idl.ScalarInfo
13. import graphql.schema.idl.SchemaGeneratorHelperExt
14. import graphql.schema.visibility.NoIntrospectionGraphqlFieldVisibility
15. import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory
16. import kotlin.reflect.KClass
17. 
18. /**
19.  * Parses a GraphQL Schema and maps object fields to provided class methods.
20.  *
21.  * @author Andrew Potter
22.  */
23. class SchemaParser internal constructor(
24.     scanResult: ScannedSchemaObjects,
25.     private val options: SchemaParserOptions,
26.     private val runtimeWiring: RuntimeWiring
27. ) {
28.     private val log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(javaClass)
29. 
30.     companion object {
31.         @JvmStatic
32.         fun newParser() = SchemaParserBuilder()
33.     }
34. 
35.     private val dictionary = scanResult.dictionary
36.     private val definitions = scanResult.definitions
37.     private val customScalars = scanResult.customScalars
38.     private val rootInfo = scanResult.rootInfo
39.     private val fieldResolversByType = scanResult.fieldResolversByType
40.     private val unusedDefinitions = scanResult.unusedDefinitions
41. 
42.     private val extensionDefinitions = definitions.filterIsInstance<ObjectTypeExtensionDefinition>()
43.     private val inputExtensionDefinitions = definitions.filterIsInstance<InputObjectTypeExtensionDefinition>()
44. 
45.     private val objectDefinitions = (definitions.filterIsInstance<ObjectTypeDefinition>() - extensionDefinitions)
46.     private val inputObjectDefinitions = (definitions.filterIsInstance<InputObjectTypeDefinition>() - inputExtensionDefinitions)
47.     private val enumDefinitions = definitions.filterIsInstance<EnumTypeDefinition>()
48.     private val interfaceDefinitions = definitions.filterIsInstance<InterfaceTypeDefinition>()
49. 
50.     private val unionDefinitions = definitions.filterIsInstance<UnionTypeDefinition>()
51. 
52.     private val permittedTypesForObject: Set<String> = (objectDefinitions.map { it.name } +
53.         enumDefinitions.map { it.name } +
54.         interfaceDefinitions.map { it.name } +
55.         unionDefinitions.map { it.name }).toSet()
56.     private val permittedTypesForInputObject: Set<String> =
57.         (inputObjectDefinitions.map { it.name } + enumDefinitions.map { it.name }).toSet()
58. 
59.     private val codeRegistryBuilder = GraphQLCodeRegistry.newCodeRegistry()
60. 
61.     private val schemaGeneratorHelper = SchemaGeneratorHelperExt()
62.     private val schemaGeneratorDirectiveHelper = SchemaGeneratorDirectiveHelper()
63.     private val schemaDirectiveParameters = SchemaGeneratorDirectiveHelper.Parameters(null, runtimeWiring, null, codeRegistryBuilder)
64. 
65.     /**
66.      * Parses the given schema with respect to the given dictionary and returns GraphQL objects.
67.      */
68.     fun parseSchemaObjects(): SchemaObjects {
69.         if (!options.introspectionEnabled) {
70.             codeRegistryBuilder.fieldVisibility(NoIntrospectionGraphqlFieldVisibility.NO_INTROSPECTION_FIELD_VISIBILITY)
71.         }
72.         // this overrides the above introspection enabled setting obviously... todo: add documentation
73.         options.fieldVisibility?.let { codeRegistryBuilder.fieldVisibility(it) }
74. 
75.         // Create GraphQL objects
76.         val inputObjects: MutableList<GraphQLInputObjectType> = mutableListOf()
77.         inputObjectDefinitions.forEach {
78.             if (inputObjects.none { io -> io.name == it.name }) {
79.                 inputObjects.add(createInputObject(it, inputObjects, mutableSetOf()))
80.             }
81.         }
82.         val interfaces = interfaceDefinitions.map { createInterfaceObject(it, inputObjects) }
83.         val objects = objectDefinitions.map { createObject(it, interfaces, inputObjects) }
84.         val unions = unionDefinitions.map { createUnionObject(it, objects) }
85.         val enums = enumDefinitions.map { createEnumObject(it) }
86. 
87.         // Assign type resolver to interfaces now that we know all of the object types
88.         interfaces.forEach { codeRegistryBuilder.typeResolver(it, InterfaceTypeResolver(dictionary.inverse(), it, objects)) }
89.         unions.forEach { codeRegistryBuilder.typeResolver(it, UnionTypeResolver(dictionary.inverse(), it, objects)) }
90. 
91.         // Find query type and mutation/subscription type (if mutation/subscription type exists)
92.         val queryName = rootInfo.getQueryName()
93.         val mutationName = rootInfo.getMutationName()
94.         val subscriptionName = rootInfo.getSubscriptionName()
95. 
96.         val query = objects.find { it.name == queryName }
97.             ?: throw SchemaError("Expected a Query object with name '$queryName' but found none!")
98.         val mutation = objects.find { it.name == mutationName }
99.             ?: if (rootInfo.isMutationRequired()) throw SchemaError("Expected a Mutation object with name '$mutationName' but found none!") else null
100.         val subscription = objects.find { it.name == subscriptionName }
101.             ?: if (rootInfo.isSubscriptionRequired()) throw SchemaError("Expected a Subscription object with name '$subscriptionName' but found none!") else null
102. 
103.         val additionalObjects = objects.filter { o -> o != query && o != subscription && o != mutation }
104. 
105.         val types = (additionalObjects.toSet() as Set<GraphQLType>) + inputObjects + enums + interfaces + unions
106.         return SchemaObjects(query, mutation, subscription, types, codeRegistryBuilder)
107.     }
108. 
109.     /**
110.      * Parses the given schema with respect to the given dictionary and returns a GraphQLSchema
111.      */
112.     fun makeExecutableSchema(): GraphQLSchema = parseSchemaObjects().toSchema()
113. 
114.     /**
115.      * Returns any unused type definitions that were found in the schema
116.      */
117.     @Suppress("unused")
118.     fun getUnusedDefinitions(): Set<TypeDefinition<*>> = unusedDefinitions
119. 
120.     private fun createObject(objectDefinition: ObjectTypeDefinition, interfaces: List<GraphQLInterfaceType>, inputObjects: List<GraphQLInputObjectType>): GraphQLObjectType {
121.         val name = objectDefinition.name
122.         val builder = GraphQLObjectType.newObject()
123.             .name(name)
124.             .definition(objectDefinition)
125.             .description(if (objectDefinition.description != null) objectDefinition.description.content else getDocumentation(objectDefinition))
126. 
127.         builder.withDirectives(*buildDirectives(objectDefinition.directives, Introspection.DirectiveLocation.OBJECT))
128. 
129.         objectDefinition.implements.forEach { implementsDefinition ->
130.             val interfaceName = (implementsDefinition as TypeName).name
131.             builder.withInterface(interfaces.find { it.name == interfaceName }
132.                 ?: throw SchemaError("Expected interface type with name '$interfaceName' but found none!"))
133.         }
134. 
135.         objectDefinition.getExtendedFieldDefinitions(extensionDefinitions).forEach { fieldDefinition ->
136.             fieldDefinition.description
137.             builder.field { field ->
138.                 createField(field, fieldDefinition, inputObjects)
139.                 codeRegistryBuilder.dataFetcher(
140.                     FieldCoordinates.coordinates(objectDefinition.name, fieldDefinition.name),
141.                     fieldResolversByType[objectDefinition]?.get(fieldDefinition)?.createDataFetcher()
142.                         ?: throw SchemaError("No resolver method found for object type '${objectDefinition.name}' and field '${fieldDefinition.name}', this is most likely a bug with graphql-java-tools")
143.                 )
144. 
145.                 val wiredField = field.build()
146.                 GraphQLFieldDefinition.Builder(wiredField)
147.                     .clearArguments()
148.                     .arguments(wiredField.arguments)
149.             }
150.         }
151. 
152.         val objectType = builder.build()
153.         val directiveHelperParameters = SchemaGeneratorDirectiveHelper.Parameters(null, runtimeWiring, null, codeRegistryBuilder)
154. 
155.         return schemaGeneratorDirectiveHelper.onObject(objectType, directiveHelperParameters)
156.     }
157. 
158.     private fun createInputObject(definition: InputObjectTypeDefinition, inputObjects: List<GraphQLInputObjectType>,
159.                                   referencingInputObjects: MutableSet<String>): GraphQLInputObjectType {
160.         val extensionDefinitions = inputExtensionDefinitions.filter { it.name == definition.name }
161. 
162.         val builder = GraphQLInputObjectType.newInputObject()
163.             .name(definition.name)
164.             .definition(definition)
165.             .extensionDefinitions(extensionDefinitions)
166.             .description(if (definition.description != null) definition.description.content else getDocumentation(definition))
167. 
168.         builder.withDirectives(*buildDirectives(definition.directives, Introspection.DirectiveLocation.INPUT_OBJECT))
169. 
170.         referencingInputObjects.add(definition.name)
171. 
172.         (extensionDefinitions + definition).forEach {
173.             it.inputValueDefinitions.forEach { inputDefinition ->
174.                 val fieldBuilder = GraphQLInputObjectField.newInputObjectField()
175.                     .name(inputDefinition.name)
176.                     .definition(inputDefinition)
177.                     .description(if (inputDefinition.description != null) inputDefinition.description.content else getDocumentation(inputDefinition))
178.                     .defaultValue(buildDefaultValue(inputDefinition.defaultValue))
179.                     .type(determineInputType(inputDefinition.type, inputObjects, referencingInputObjects))
180.                     .withDirectives(*buildDirectives(inputDefinition.directives, Introspection.DirectiveLocation.INPUT_FIELD_DEFINITION))
181.                 builder.field(fieldBuilder.build())
182.             }
183.         }
184. 
185.         return schemaGeneratorDirectiveHelper.onInputObjectType(builder.build(), schemaDirectiveParameters)
186.     }
187. 
188.     private fun createEnumObject(definition: EnumTypeDefinition): GraphQLEnumType {
189.         val name = definition.name
190.         val type = dictionary[definition]
191.             ?: throw SchemaError("Expected enum with name '$name' but found none!")
192.         if (!type.unwrap().isEnum) throw SchemaError("Type '$name' is declared as an enum in the GraphQL schema but is not a Java enum!")
193. 
194.         val builder = GraphQLEnumType.newEnum()
195.             .name(name)
196.             .definition(definition)
197.             .description(if (definition.description != null) definition.description.content else getDocumentation(definition))
198. 
199.         builder.withDirectives(*buildDirectives(definition.directives, Introspection.DirectiveLocation.ENUM))
200. 
201.         definition.enumValueDefinitions.forEach { enumDefinition ->
202.             val enumName = enumDefinition.name
203.             val enumValue = type.unwrap().enumConstants.find { (it as Enum<*>).name == enumName }
204.                 ?: throw SchemaError("Expected value for name '$enumName' in enum '${type.unwrap().simpleName}' but found none!")
205. 
206.             val enumValueDirectives = buildDirectives(enumDefinition.directives, Introspection.DirectiveLocation.ENUM_VALUE)
207.             getDeprecated(enumDefinition.directives).let {
208.                 val enumValueDefinition = GraphQLEnumValueDefinition.newEnumValueDefinition()
209.                     .name(enumName)
210.                     .description(if (enumDefinition.description != null) enumDefinition.description.content else getDocumentation(enumDefinition))
211.                     .value(enumValue)
212.                     .deprecationReason(it)
213.                     .withDirectives(*enumValueDirectives)
214.                     .definition(enumDefinition)
215.                     .build()
216. 
217.                 builder.value(enumValueDefinition)
218.             }
219.         }
220. 
221.         return schemaGeneratorDirectiveHelper.onEnum(builder.build(), schemaDirectiveParameters)
222.     }
223. 
224.     private fun createInterfaceObject(interfaceDefinition: InterfaceTypeDefinition, inputObjects: List<GraphQLInputObjectType>): GraphQLInterfaceType {
225.         val name = interfaceDefinition.name
226.         val builder = GraphQLInterfaceType.newInterface()
227.             .name(name)
228.             .definition(interfaceDefinition)
229.             .description(if (interfaceDefinition.description != null) interfaceDefinition.description.content else getDocumentation(interfaceDefinition))
230. 
231.         builder.withDirectives(*buildDirectives(interfaceDefinition.directives, Introspection.DirectiveLocation.INTERFACE))
232. 
233.         interfaceDefinition.fieldDefinitions.forEach { fieldDefinition ->
234.             builder.field { field -> createField(field, fieldDefinition, inputObjects) }
235.         }
236. 
237.         interfaceDefinition.implements.forEach { implementsDefinition ->
238.             val interfaceName = (implementsDefinition as TypeName).name
239.             builder.withInterface(GraphQLTypeReference(interfaceName))
240.         }
241. 
242.         return schemaGeneratorDirectiveHelper.onInterface(builder.build(), schemaDirectiveParameters)
243.     }
244. 
245.     private fun createUnionObject(definition: UnionTypeDefinition, types: List<GraphQLObjectType>): GraphQLUnionType {
246.         val name = definition.name
247.         val builder = GraphQLUnionType.newUnionType()
248.             .name(name)
249.             .definition(definition)
250.             .description(if (definition.description != null) definition.description.content else getDocumentation(definition))
251. 
252.         builder.withDirectives(*buildDirectives(definition.directives, Introspection.DirectiveLocation.UNION))
253. 
254.         getLeafUnionObjects(definition, types).forEach { builder.possibleType(it) }
255.         return schemaGeneratorDirectiveHelper.onUnion(builder.build(), schemaDirectiveParameters)
256.     }
257. 
258.     private fun getLeafUnionObjects(definition: UnionTypeDefinition, types: List<GraphQLObjectType>): List<GraphQLObjectType> {
259.         val name = definition.name
260.         val leafObjects = mutableListOf<GraphQLObjectType>()
261. 
262.         definition.memberTypes.forEach {
263.             val typeName = (it as TypeName).name
264. 
265.             // Is this a nested union? If so, expand
266.             val nestedUnion: UnionTypeDefinition? = unionDefinitions.find { otherDefinition -> typeName == otherDefinition.name }
267. 
268.             if (nestedUnion != null) {
269.                 leafObjects.addAll(getLeafUnionObjects(nestedUnion, types))
270.             } else {
271.                 leafObjects.add(types.find { type -> type.name == typeName }
272.                     ?: throw SchemaError("Expected object type '$typeName' for union type '$name', but found none!"))
273.             }
274.         }
275.         return leafObjects
276.     }
277. 
278.     private fun createField(field: GraphQLFieldDefinition.Builder, fieldDefinition: FieldDefinition, inputObjects: List<GraphQLInputObjectType>): GraphQLFieldDefinition.Builder {
279.         field
280.             .name(fieldDefinition.name)
281.             .description(fieldDefinition.description?.content ?: getDocumentation(fieldDefinition))
282.             .definition(fieldDefinition)
283.             .apply { getDeprecated(fieldDefinition.directives)?.let { deprecate(it) } }
284.             .type(determineOutputType(fieldDefinition.type, inputObjects))
285. 
286.         fieldDefinition.inputValueDefinitions.forEach { argumentDefinition ->
287.             val argumentBuilder = GraphQLArgument.newArgument()
